crop.notes: Clipping covers cricket, kennel, trapshooting, Goss-Ryan and swimming items; only the short 'Allen and Greenfield' item (crop-4) is about Allen.

ocr.notes: Allen item reads correctly apart from 'Jim Muce' (Mace) and 'Alicn'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that English heavyweight Alfred Greenfield challenged Tom Allen; Allen posted a forfeit and agreed to fight in a sixteen-foot ring for £200 a side and a £200 cup.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 30, 1880, page 13. Current title ('Jem Mace Defeats Tom Allen') is wrong; Mace is only named as a comparison.

facts.fact: Alfred Greenfield, the English heavyweight who had beaten Jack Stewart, challenged Allen for £200 or £500 or a £1,000 champion trophy
Allen posted a forfeit and agreed to meet Greenfield in a sixteen-foot rather than twenty-four-foot ring, for £200 a side and a champion cup valued at £200
